csrPage.title: Goodness grows when we grow together.
csrPage.description: We believe a responsible business should care for the people and places behind every ingredient. Our focus is to listen, build useful partnerships and share progress with honesty.
csrPage.heroImageAlt: Green Kerala hills and tree-covered growing landscapes
csrPage.introText: Our roots are in a place, a craft and the people who make it possible. We want our work to create value beyond the product: through respectful relationships, thoughtful use of resources and community partnerships shaped by real needs.

commitments.title: People and livelihoods
commitments.text: We aim to build long-term relationships with the people and partners connected to our supply chain, with respect for skill, experience and fair opportunity.

commitments.title: Health and wellbeing
commitments.text: We see access to care as an important part of a thriving community. We will work with trusted local partners where our contribution can be useful and accountable.

commitments.title: Care for the land
commitments.text: Healthy growing landscapes support both livelihoods and the ingredients we value. We are committed to learning how our choices can support more responsible sourcing.

csrPage.communityTitle: Listen first. Work together. Share progress.
csrPage.communityText: Good community work begins with listening. We want to learn from local organisations and communities, support initiatives with clear purpose, and be transparent about what has been done and what still needs work.
csrPage.communityImageAlt: A healthcare professional in a clinic, shown as an illustrative image
csrPage.communityImageNote: Illustrative photo; it does not depict an Elacher Ghor programme.
csrPage.closingText: We will use this space to share verified initiatives and measurable progress as partnerships develop. For community or sustainability enquiries, contact our team.
